visual_action: The video uses a split-screen format. The top half shows Donald Trump at a rally, first with his hand over his heart and then saluting. The bottom half initially shows a large screen at the rally displaying a person in an orange prison jumpsuit with their head bowed. It then cuts to various clips of the January 6th Capitol attack, showing chaotic scenes of rioters clashing with police.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is shown on screen at a rally and named in the on-screen text: "TRUMP PLAYS AN ALTERED VERSION..." and "'Justice for All' by Donald J. Trump..."

cast.name: J6 Prison Choir
cast.evidence: Named in the on-screen text, "'Justice for All' by Donald J. Trump & J6 Prison Choir." Their singing of the national anthem is the sole audio of the video.

cast.name: January 6th Insurrectionists
cast.evidence: Referred to in the on-screen text as "INSURRECTIONISTS." Video footage of the January 6th Capitol attack is shown.

on_screen_text.text: TRUMP PLAYS AN ALTERED VERSION OF THE NATIONAL ANTHEM FEATURING INSURRECTIONISTS AT HIS RALLIES
"Justice for All" by Donald J. Trump & J6 Prison Choir

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue. The audio consists of a male choir singing a somber version of the U.S. National Anthem, identified by on-screen text as a performance by the "J6 Prison Choir."
audio_music: A slow, solemn, and grave-sounding male choir rendition of the U.S. National Anthem plays throughout the video. The tone is funereal rather than celebratory.
editing_pacing: The video uses a split-screen layout with slow cuts between different archival clips, creating a deliberate and serious pace that matches the somber music.
central_claim: Donald Trump honors January 6th insurrectionists at his rallies by playing a version of the national anthem that they recorded.
intended_effect: To generate disapproval of Donald Trump by associating him and patriotic symbols with the January 6th Capitol attack.
uncertainty_flags: The source of the 'LIVE HOUSTON, TX' chyron is unclear; it may be from an original broadcast or added by the video's creator.
The logo in the bottom left appears to be from 'Inside Edition', suggesting the footage was sourced from a news report, but it is not perfectly clear.
